title: Game registry (data/games.json)
description: One row per title; rules that span rows (unique keys, migrations, icon files, built paths) are in contracts/games.md.

code.description: Voices topics carry the code: contracts/voices.schema.json `game`.
Internal id; never renamed (D1 games.code, voices topics, saved filters).

slug.description: URL segment of /<slug>/ and /events/<slug>/<pref>/; null = none.

hub.description: build.py builds the hub /<slug>/ (noindex while thin: docs/design/game-hub.md, section 8).

label.description: Display name: items.json `game`, GAME_ICON key, /events/ chip and column name.

official.description: Official title name (title pages; D1 games.name for events games).

short.description: Common short name: title page titles / h1, event landing pages.

title_alt.description: Second name in a title page's <title>.

aliases.description: Names people search with (title page keywords and about text).

icon.description: public/gi/ file or a one-character monogram; null = first character of the label.

slot.description: Palette slot: CLAUDE.md › Event game palette, contracts/voices.md › Game codes.

colour.description: null = the release calendar's computed hue.

official_url.description: 公式 link of the title's releases (a host is required).

bit.description: Power of two; D1 games.bit; never changes.
